security.title: Account security

security.totpSecret: Add this key to your authenticator app:
security.totpFailed: We couldn't turn on the authenticator app.
security.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices

team.title: Team
team.notAllowed: Only the owner and admins can see and manage the team.

roleHelp.admin: Manages properties, guides, and the team.
roleHelp.agent: Handles guest conversations. Never sees access codes.

team.sent: Invitation sent to {email}. The link expires in 7 days.
team.resent: We resent the invitation with a new link.
team.revoked: Invitation revoked; the link no longer works.
team.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the workspace? They lose access right away.
team.removed: {name} is no longer in the workspace.

invite.title: You're invited to {workspace}
invite.signInToAccept: Sign in or create your account with the email the invitation was sent to.
invite.mismatch: This invitation to {workspace} is for another email address. Sign out and sign in with the address the invitation was sent to.
invite.gone: This invitation is no longer valid. It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.

workspace.switchFailed: We couldn't switch workspaces. Try again.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.transferBody: The new owner must be an admin. You stay on as an admin.
workspace.transferNone: First make someone on the team an admin.
workspace.leaveBody: You lose access to this workspace. Your other workspaces don't change.
workspace.leaveOwner: As the owner, first transfer ownership to an admin.
workspace.deleteBody: We tell the whole team. You can restore it for 30 days; after that it's deleted for good. Type the workspace name to confirm.
workspace.deleted: The workspace will be deleted on {date}.
workspace.pendingBody: It will be deleted on {date}. Until then you can restore it.
workspace.readOnly: Only the owner and admins can change the workspace.

account.title: Your account
account.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
account.changed: Done: your account now uses {email}. We signed you out on your other devices.
account.exportBody: Download a file with your profile, workspaces, devices, and security activity.
account.deleteBody: We sign you out everywhere and delete your account in 30 days. Signing in again before then cancels it.
account.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? Your account will be deleted in 30 days.

log.title: Security log
log.noAccess: Only the owner and admins see the workspace log.
